subject: pri-info-td
title: PRI.VT.TD.------PROG.CONT.
description: Chart on book p. 457 (MP(I)-31). PRI-INFO-TD is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) is the partner. The title names PRI-VT-TD (principle vibrational tendencies); the chart has no label for it. From the subject: ACC-F (accelerated functionalism) and COS-P (cosmic particulars). From ACC-F: MTH (methodology), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", and VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). From COS-P: C-CONT (composite continuance). From VT-DY: INFO-DY (information dynamics). From C-CONT: IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics). From IF-ST-DY: IST-F (isolated focus). From IST-F: INFO-TRNS (information transference).
